title: Order Intake Standard — Prescribed Pressure Changes on PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Prescribed Pressure Changes — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Standard.** The prescribed pressure of a PAP Therapy Equipment device is changed only on a new written order from the treating practitioner, never on the patient's request alone and never by the agent: a pressure is changed only after a pressure change request on this device record is approved. Whether such a request on this device record is approved is read from the system's records.

**Range of the class.** The new pressure must lie within the class's highest pressure in cmH2O; a pressure the class cannot deliver needs a new order for a different class, under the one-coverage-billed-device rules of PAP Therapy Equipment.

**Order date.** The new order date restarts the class's written-order validity in months for supply cycles.

## Conditions for a change

| New written order from the treating practitioner | Pressure change request on this record approved | New pressure within the class's highest pressure | Pressure changed on this device |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | yes |
| yes | yes | no | no — a different class needs a new order |
| patient's request only | any | any | no |

**Example (hypothetical order).** A patient on a CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601), whose class delivers up to 20 cmH2O, has an approved pressure change request for 14 cmH2O: the pressure is changed and the new order date starts a new 12-month validity for supply cycles. An order for 22 cmH2O lies beyond the class and calls for a new order for a different class.
